{{Quote|I am Master Tho'natu of the Jedi. We're here to help you.''"<br />"''No! You'll never get me! No! No! No!|Tho'natu and Darovit|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
A '''confrontation''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] in [[990 BBY]] that culminated in a short [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] between the failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darovit]] and a [[Ambria strike team|team]] of fourteen Jedi. Darovit had discovered his cousin, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she was undercover as a [[Nalia Adollu|Jedi]]. Fearing she would be discovered, Zannah took Darovit to her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. They were followed by a group of Jedi who [[Duel on Tython|engaged]] Zannah and Bane in a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]], and although the Jedi were [[Death/Legends|killed]], Bane suffered life-threatening injuries. After the duel, Zannah took Bane to the healer [[Caleb]] on Ambria, who refused to heal the dying Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] unless Zannah surrendered her Master to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Zannah accepted Caleb's demands and sent word to the Jedi that a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] still lived.

Zannah, however, betrayed and murdered Caleb after his part of the bargain was upheld. She then used [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] to [[Summon fear|drive]] Darovit insane and furnished him with a [[Color/Legends|gold]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. When a team of six [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and eight [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] led by Master [[Tho'natu]] arrived on Ambria to arrest the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord, they were attacked by the insane Darovit. Believing him to be the Dark Lord, the Jedi quickly cut him down. Assuming the Sith had finally been eliminated from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Jedi left the planet, allowing Bane's [[Order of the Sith Lords]] to survive. The Sith remained hidden from the Jedi for nearly a [[Time/Legends|millennium]], until they finally [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|revealed]] themselves with the power to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|take over]] the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Prelude==
[[File:DarthBane-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Bane]]
{{Quote|Bane's time is running out. You have to decide.''"<br />"''Tell Caleb I agree to his demands.|Darovit, pleading for Zannah to save her Master and return to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]]|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
[[Darovit]]&mdash;a failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and redeemed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&mdash;traveled to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[990 BBY]], where he planned to reveal that he knew of two [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] who had survived the [[New Sith Wars]]. Before he was able to speak out, however, he found his cousin, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], who was in disguise as [[Nalia Adollu]], a Padawan who had been stationed on the planet [[Polus]] since [[995 BBY]]. Fearing that she would be exposed, Zannah fled, taking Darovit with her to meet her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Nevertheless, a group of five Jedi led by [[Jedi Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] tracked down the Sith and [[Duel on Tython|engaged]] Zannah and Bane in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]].<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />

Although the Jedi were [[Death/Legends|slaughtered]], several of the parasitic, impenetrable [[orbalisk]]s that formed Bane's [[Orbalisk armor|armor]] were killed by his own expulsion of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. The orbalisks released deadly [[Poison/Legends|toxins]] into his body for which there was no known antidote. Zannah took Bane and Darovit aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Loranda (starship)|''Loranda'']] and flew to the planet [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] to find the healer [[Caleb]], who had saved Bane's life [[1000 BBY/Legends|ten]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier, during the New Sith Wars. However, Caleb had only healed Bane because the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] had threatened to harm his [[Serra|daughter]]. Fearing that Bane would return and threaten her again, the healer had sent his daughter away, forcing her to move to another planet and change her name so that she could never be tracked down; Caleb himself did not know her location. The healer further resisted Zannah's attempts to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] him into compliance, and Darovit suggested that Caleb might heal Bane if Zannah called in the Jedi to arrest her Master.<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />

[[File:DarthZannah-DoE.png|thumb|right|140px|Darth Zannah]]
Caleb agreed to the idea, but Zannah was hesitant, as there was still much for her to learn from her Master. If she turned him over to the Jedi, she knew that many secrets of the Sith he had not yet revealed to her would likely be lost forever. On the other hand, if she did not send the message, Bane would die and the secrets definitely would be lost. Darovit pressured her to save Bane's life, join the Jedi when they came, and turn away from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Finally, realizing that she had no choice, Zannah accepted the plan. She sent a [[message drone]] to the Jedi, and Caleb healed Bane, who eventually regained consciousness. When Zannah told her still-weakened Master what she had done, he expressed his anger and told her to kill him rather than allow him to fall into the hands of the Jedi. Zannah, however, had formulated a plan&mdash;she murdered Caleb, mutilated the healer's corpse, and used her [[Summon fear|skills]] in [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] to drive Darovit insane. She then gave Darovit Farfalla's [[Color/Legends|gold]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with the intention of having Darovit attack the Jedi when they arrived.<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />

==The confrontation==
{{Quote|A Sith Lord still lives. He killed five Jedi on Tython. He is now on Ambria, under the care of a healer named Caleb. He is badly injured and helpless.|Zannah's message to the Jedi|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
Zannah hid herself and her Master in a small trapdoor inside [[Caleb's hut]] and [[Spell of concealment|hid their presences]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] so that the Jedi would not sense them. Meanwhile, a [[Ambria strike team|team]] of six [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and eight [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] led by the Jedi Master [[Tho'natu]] arrived on Ambria in the [[Cruiser/Legends|Jedi cruiser]] ''[[Light of Truth]]'' to take the Sith into custody. The Jedi quickly found the [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismembered]] corpse of Caleb outside of the healer's shack. Moving toward the hut, Tho'natu called out to the Sith that they had arrived and were there to help. Darovit then emerged, screaming and brandishing the golden lightsaber of the recently fallen Farfalla. He attacked Tho'natu and the other Jedi, who [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fell upon]] him and killed him in [[Standard second|seconds]].<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|One day I will surpass you. And on that day, I ''will'' kill you. But that day is not today.|Zannah, to Darth Bane|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
[[File:Darthcog.jpg|thumb|left|130px|The Huntress]]
Recalling that Farfalla had used a golden lightsaber, Tho'natu assumed that Darovit was the Sith Lord who had killed the Jedi on Tython. Noticing that Darovit was missing one [[Limb/Legends|hand]], he also surmised that Darovit had been grievously injured and had come to Caleb for help. Tho'natu further inferred that the healer had sent the message to the Jedi shortly after Darovit's arrival, but Darovit had found out and, once healed, had killed Caleb in retaliation. The Jedi, mistakenly convinced that they had finally destroyed the last of the Sith, took Caleb's remains to Coruscant for a proper burial and left the ''Loranda'' for [[Scavenger/Legends|junkers]]. Zannah and Bane escaped a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later in the starship, and Bane expressed his approval of Zannah's actions.<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />

The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] honored the five fallen Jedi who had been killed at Tython by engraving their names and images on a white block of stone, in which their [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilts]] were also inlaid, and Caleb was honored on the list as well. Jedi Master [[Obba]], who had been a member of Tho'natu's strike team and who by [[980 BBY]] had become a member of the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]], recounted the events of the confrontation to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Serra of [[Doan]], who was actually Caleb's daughter. Upon hearing the Jedi's description of the insane man they had killed, Serra became convinced that the Jedi had been fooled&mdash;she remembered Bane's appearance from her childhood and was certain he had survived. She thus hired an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]], to hunt down Bane and [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|capture]] him. Nevertheless, Bane escaped and enlisted the Huntress as his Sith apprentice; and she proceeded to kill Serra.<ref name="DoE" />

Zannah's actions allowed [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bane's [[Order of the Sith Lords]] to remain hidden from the Jedi for nearly a millennium&mdash;990 BBY to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]&mdash;permitting them to grow in power until they were strong enough to take on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] once more.<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" /><ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Sith succeeded in [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|eradicating]] the Jedi Order and [[Declaration of a New Order|establishing]] the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The confrontation was created by author [[Drew Karpyshyn]] for his [[2007]] novel, ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''. The event served to present the deaths of two established characters, Caleb and Darovit; Karpyshyn also used the event as the origin of the Jedi Order's belief that the Sith were extinct, as presented in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. The confrontation later received mention in ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', the sequel to ''Rule of Two'' and the final installment in Karpyshyn's [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']]. In the novel, Caleb's daughter is told of the events of the confrontation from the Jedi's point of view.
